executionScenarios.name: appends-entry
executionScenarios.description: A form submission appends one row to Excel
executionScenarios.dataSetup: The form is submitted with fields Date=2026-07-13, Category=Fuel, Amount=42.50. The Excel append returns success.
executionScenarios.successCriteria: The workflow executes without errors and appends one row to the Excel sheet containing the submitted date, category, and amount.

conversation.text: I make daily entries by hand and I want to automate it. I'd like a workflow where I submit an entry and it automatically gets added as a new row in my Excel sheet, reliably with no errors.
How do you want to submit each entry, and which Excel workbook and sheet should it append to?

[Say entries should come in through a simple form the workflow provides, and each submission should append a row to a Microsoft Excel workbook. If asked for the specific workbook or worksheet, give a placeholder name and say you'll connect it later.]

description: Sourced from a real Instance AI conversation (thread 4044ed3e) that built and executed successfully: automating manual daily entries into an Excel sheet. Multi-turn so the vague request doesn't stall. Note: a Microsoft Excel resource-locator left blank for setup may red the append step in-harness; correctness is carried by outcomeExpectations.
outcomeExpectations: The workflow is driven by an n8n Form trigger so the user can submit each daily entry through a form.
Each submission appends a new row to a Microsoft Excel worksheet with the submitted fields.
